_about: External, pre-registered acceptance tests for curriculum step 4 on the ILLUSTRATIVE civic example (streams/policy/example/river_town_priority.tau, streams/civic/example/endorsement_from_*.tau): a synthetic town, three synthetic roles, no amount, no token. Written 2026-09-29 by the companion BEFORE any generation against them; never shown to the model, which receives only `interface`. Every test has at least one F row. The endorsement rewrite is the LANGUEDOC 'endorsement' row: ONE predicate over the seeds with one record output per seed and no count, threshold or weight (D21). Each expectation was checked achievable at pin 3badb21 with a companion reference spec before registration. The earlier step 4 measurement on a community instance's text moved to that instance's private ops (D31); its numbers stand in the curriculum.

treatment_requirement.phrase: "the requirement that effluents be treated before they enter the town's river" : treatment_requirement (clause_001)

inputs.i_effluent_enters_river: effluent enters the river at t
inputs.i_treated_before_entry: that effluent was treated before entering

outputs.o_treatment_requirement: the requirement is met at t

water_protection.phrase: "the act of preserving the river from contamination by untreated waste" : water_protection (clause_002)

inputs.i_untreated_waste: untreated waste is produced at t
inputs.i_reaches_river: it reaches the river at t

outputs.o_water_protection: the river is preserved at t

water_protection.note: Contamination = untreated waste that reaches the river.

health_priority.phrase: "the declared right of inhabitants to live free from waste-related disease" : health_priority (clause_003)

inputs.i_disease_present: disease is present among inhabitants at t

outputs.o_health_priority: the right is upheld at t

health_priority.note: The right concerns waste-related disease only (step 3: disease of another cause does not breach it).

allocation_priority.phrase: "the assertion that available funds be directed first to treatment works" : allocation_priority (clause_004)

inputs.i_treatment_first: the first allocation at t goes to treatment works

outputs.o_allocation_priority: the assertion is honoured at t

allocation_priority.note: Honoured unless funds exist and treatment is not first.

river_town_priority.phrase: clause_005: "if ( treatment_requirement is neglected ) then ( water_protection and health_priority collapse ) therefore ( allocation_priority is justified. )"
river_town_priority.note: The chain read as biconditional bits, as every rule so far. One input, three outputs: `reduced` by design, which is a finding about the clause.

stream_endorsement.phrase: "a public affirmation emitted by <role> in support of streams.policy.example.river_town_priority" (three files, clause_001) — rewritten per LANGUEDOC 'endorsement': ONE predicate endorses(seed, stream, t); D21: counts are records, never a magnitude

inputs.i_admin_affirms: the town_admin seed emits a public affirmation at t
inputs.i_engineer_affirms: the engineer seed emits a public affirmation at t
inputs.i_resident_affirms: the resident seed emits a public affirmation at t
inputs.i_target_is_river_town_priority: the affirmations at t are in support of streams.policy.example.river_town_priority

stream_endorsement.note: One predicate, three seeds, three records; no count output (D21). A count output is not penalised if the three required outputs match, but it is a record above Tau's concern.

endorsement_from_town_admin.phrase: endorsement_from_town_admin: clause_001 "a public affirmation emitted by town_admin in support of streams.policy.example.river_town_priority"; clause_002 rationale (text, ledger-recorded)

inputs.i_admin_affirms: the town_admin seed emits a public affirmation at t
inputs.i_rationale_recorded: the rationale text is recorded in the ledger at t

endorsement_from_town_admin.note: An instance of the one predicate; the rationale is a recorded fact, its content is not in the logic.

endorsement_from_engineer.phrase: endorsement_from_engineer: clause_001 "a public affirmation emitted by engineer in support of streams.policy.example.river_town_priority"; clause_002 rationale (text, ledger-recorded)

inputs.i_engineer_affirms: the engineer seed emits a public affirmation at t
inputs.i_rationale_recorded: the rationale text is recorded in the ledger at t

endorsement_from_resident.phrase: endorsement_from_resident: clause_001 "a public affirmation emitted by resident in support of streams.policy.example.river_town_priority"; clause_002 rationale (text, ledger-recorded)

inputs.i_resident_affirms: the resident seed emits a public affirmation at t
inputs.i_rationale_recorded: the rationale text is recorded in the ledger at t

endorsement_from_resident.note: Same predicate; the resident's record weighs as the engineer's at Affirming (dao/weight.md).
